incoming.name: Comics
incoming.excerpt: Comics artists will generally sketch a drawing in pencil before going over the drawing again in ink, using either a dip pen or a brush.

incoming.name: Pig
incoming.excerpt: Their bristly hairs are also used for brushes.

outgoing.name: Aluminium
outgoing.excerpt: Metal ferrules may be of aluminium, nickel, copper, or nickel-plated steel.

outgoing.name: Copper
outgoing.excerpt: Metal ferrules may be of aluminium, nickel, copper, or nickel-plated steel.

outgoing.name: Nickel
outgoing.excerpt: Handles may be wood or plastic; ferrules are metal (usually nickel-plated steel).

outgoing.name: Pig
outgoing.excerpt: Bristles may be natural -- either soft hair or hog bristle -- or synthetic.

outgoing.name: Steel
outgoing.excerpt: Handles may be wood or plastic; ferrules are metal (usually nickel-plated steel).

outgoing.name: Wood
outgoing.excerpt: Artists' brush handles are commonly wooden, but the cheapest brushes may have moulded plastic handles.
